_note: Screening set written by the team/assistant for MODEL SELECTION ONLY. Not part of the final test set (real grandma phrases collected from family are the test set).

darija_to_x.darija: يا كبدتي، إمتى غادي تجي؟ الله يرضي عليك أوليدي.
darija_to_x.latin: a kebdti, imta ghadi tji? lah yrdi 3lik a wlidi.
darija_to_x.meaning_en: My darling, when are you coming? God bless you, my dear boy.
I love you so much, my dear girl (I pray God keeps you in my life).

darija_to_x.darija: واش كليتي مزيان؟ ما تبقاش تسهر بزاف.
darija_to_x.latin: wach kliti mzyan? ma tb9ach tsehher bzaf.
darija_to_x.meaning_en: Have you been eating well? Don't stay up too late.

darija_to_x.darija: توحشتك بزاف، الدار خاوية بلا بيك.
darija_to_x.latin: twe7chtek bzaf, ddar khawya bla bik.
darija_to_x.meaning_en: I miss you so much, the house feels empty without you.

darija_to_x.latin: lah y7fdek w ynjjhek f qraytek.
darija_to_x.meaning_en: May God protect you and help you succeed in your studies.
Your uncle called today, he says hi.

darija_to_x.darija: الشتا طاحت اليوم بزاف، الحمد لله.
darija_to_x.meaning_en: It rained a lot today, thank God.

darija_to_x.darija: اللي بغا العسل يصبر لقريص النحل.
darija_to_x.latin: lli bgha l3sel ysber l9ris n7el.
darija_to_x.meaning_en: If you want the honey, you have to put up with the bee stings (no pain, no gain).

darija_to_x.darija: وليتي طويل بحال النخلة، ولكن مازال ما عرفتيش تطيب!
darija_to_x.latin: wlliti twil b7al nkhla, walakin mazal ma 3reftich ttiyeb!
darija_to_x.meaning_en: You've grown as tall as a palm tree, but you still don't know how to cook!

darija_to_x.darija: يا عينيا، نتا اللي عندي فهاد الدنيا.
darija_to_x.latin: a 3iniya, nta lli 3ndi f had ddenya.
darija_to_x.meaning_en: My dear, you mean everything to me in this world.

x_to_darija.text: Mamie, tu me manques tellement. Je viens cet été, promis !
x_to_darija.meaning_en: Grandma, I miss you so much. I'm coming this summer, I promise!

x_to_darija.text: Abuela, te quiero mucho. ¿Cómo estás de salud? Tómate tus medicinas.
x_to_darija.meaning_en: Grandma, I love you so much. How is your health? Take your medicine.

x_to_darija.text: Nonna, ho passato l'esame! Grazie per tutte le tue preghiere.
x_to_darija.meaning_en: Grandma, I passed the exam! Thank you for all your prayers.

x_to_darija.text: Grandma, I got into university! I really miss your couscous.
x_to_darija.meaning_en: Grandma, I got into university! I really miss your couscous.
